title: Dramatic Ocean Waves Crashing on Rocks
place: Rocky coast with a small stone structure on a sea rock (location not given on page)
notes: Long-lens shot of a sea rock topped by a small ruined stone hut/structure (x~0.3-0.45, y~0.3-0.5), rough white sea around it. 0-3 s: swell builds behind the rock (x~0.5-0.9). 3-4.5 s: a huge wave rears up right of the rock (x~0.55-0.9). 4.6-6 s: it explodes against the rock - a white wall of water rises taller than the rock and swallows it (x~0.3-0.9, then full frame). 6-8.5 s: the whole frame is a cloud of spray/mist, rock invisible. 8.5-10.5 s: mist clears and the rock and hut reappear, still standing. No people, text or logos. Shot A 1.8-4.5 s, Shot B 4.5-7.2 s, optional Shot C 7.6-10.3 s (reveal).
fact_en: Page description: "Dynamic ocean waves crash against rocky coastal cliffs."
